single_agent.instruction: Inspect only the supplied cutoff-safe rolling-observation/v2. Select exactly three distinct allowed action IDs including rolling-fifo-open. Use the short/previous/long state views, live HP queue age, forecast uncertainty, SLO progress and control-distance trade-off. Preserve a useful contrast among FIFO, predictive admission, immediate preemption and checkpoint-loss-aware preemption. Do not inspect future arrivals, invent parameters, predict a winner or perform placement. Return strict JSON with one bounded reason_code and the three IDs; deterministic simulation and SLO audit choose the action.

multi_agent.analyst_instruction: Inspect only the supplied cutoff-safe rolling-observation/v2. Return structured workload_regime, short-vs-long change, live HP queue/SLO risk, calibrated forecast risk, uncertainty, and recommended action characteristics. Explicitly distinguish urgent HP protection from ordinary Spot-heavy operation. Do not select a winner, inspect future arrivals, invent metrics or perform placement.
multi_agent.strategist_instruction: Use the supplied cutoff-safe state view plus the supplied verified Workload Analyst receipt. Select exactly three distinct allowed action IDs including rolling-fifo-open. Use only evidence present in those two inputs and preserve a useful contrast among registered controls. Do not infer the experimental arm, predict a winner, inspect future arrivals, invent parameters or perform placement. Return strict JSON with one bounded reason_code and the three IDs; deterministic simulation and SLO audit choose the action.

multi_agent_masked.analyst_instruction: Return the fixed masked handoff object only: {"masked":true,"content":"withheld-for-causal-ablation"}. Do not summarize the observation or name an action.
multi_agent_masked.strategist_instruction: Use the supplied cutoff-safe state view plus the supplied verified Workload Analyst receipt. Select exactly three distinct allowed action IDs including rolling-fifo-open. Use only evidence present in those two inputs and preserve a useful contrast among registered controls. Do not infer the experimental arm, predict a winner, inspect future arrivals, invent parameters or perform placement. Return strict JSON with one bounded reason_code and the three IDs; deterministic simulation and SLO audit choose the action.

matched_resources: three candidate simulations per decision scenario
state-equivalent de-identified Strategist view, identical Strategist instruction, action catalog, simulator and SLO hierarchy
causal_ablation.changed_factor: The Strategist receives structured Analyst content or the fixed mask; later state may diverge only as a downstream treatment effect.

output_contract.candidate_action_ids: exactly three unique allowed IDs including rolling-fifo-open
output_contract.role_receipts: AgentTeams project/task/worker identity and SHA-256 of each normalized stage output
